closing: That is the roundup for now.

topics.title: Antarctic sea ice posts a low winter maximum
topics.summary: Antarctic sea ice reached its third-lowest winter maximum in 2026, according to a ScienceDaily report on new research. Scientists said the reversal follows years of record-breaking growth and are examining whether it marks a lasting shift in Antarctica's frozen landscape.
topics.detail: The report said the annual winter peak came in September 2026 and covered about 17.59 million square kilometers. It said the extent ranked third lowest in the satellite record. Researchers said they are continuing to track the ice to see whether the decline is a lasting transformation or falls within natural variability.

sources.title: Antarctica's sea ice has undergone a stunning reversal

topics.title: Thwaites Glacier modeled to keep losing ice
topics.summary: British Antarctic Survey said new research found Thwaites Glacier in West Antarctica will continue losing ice for at least the next 150 years, even under extreme ocean cooling. The study was published on 13 October 2026 in Geophysical Research Letters.
topics.detail: The BAS report said the glacier kept losing ice throughout the full 150-year simulation period, even without any ocean melting. It said the finding adds to calls for policymakers to prepare for sea-level rise. The study was led by Rosie Williams, Matt Trevers, Sainan Sun, Paul Holland, David T. Bett, Robert Arthern and Alexander T. Bradley.

sources.title: Thwaites Glacier will keep losing ice even if oceans cool

topics.title: UCI cancels urban cycling world championships
topics.summary: Cycling Weekly reported that the UCI cancelled the 2026 Urban Cycling World Championships in Saudi Arabia after missile strikes on the country's capital. The report said the decision affected the event planned for Saudi Arabia.
topics.detail: The article said the cancellation followed missile strikes on an airport in the country. It identified the event as the 2026 Urban Cycling World Championships. No additional details were provided in the article excerpt.

sources.title: UCI cancels World Championships in Saudi Arabia after missile strikes on airport

topics.title: Kilauea episode 55 ends abruptly
topics.summary: USGS said episode 55 of the ongoing Halemaʻumaʻu eruption at Kilauea ended abruptly on 17 October 2026. The volcano remained at WATCH with an ORANGE aviation color code in a separate notice.
topics.detail: A later USGS notice said the alert level and aviation color code remained at WATCH and ORANGE, and conditions could change rapidly. Another notice said the eruption had ended at 9:03 a.m. HST on 17 October. The notices were posted on 17 October 2026.

sources.title: Volcano Updates | U.S. Geological Survey - USGS.gov

topics.title: Great Sitkin continues erupting slowly
topics.summary: USGS said lava continued to erupt slowly within the summit crater of Great Sitkin Volcano on 15 and 17 October 2026. The notices said unrest continued with elevated seismic activity and small earthquakes.
topics.detail: The 17 October notice said the volcano remained at ADVISORY with a YELLOW aviation color code. The 15 October notice said one small earthquake was detected in the past day and that clouds obscured satellite and webcam views. Both notices described continuing unrest at the volcano.
